sources.note: Own site: identity and that it makes wine at Nashik. Its contact page publishes no address in the served HTML.

notes: Coordinates come from the producer's own OpenStreetMap POI (craft=winery, Gangapur-Savargaon Road, Nashik), the only one of this batch that Nominatim resolved to the productive unit. Remote sales were not reviewed.

sources.note: Own site publishes the winery address at Gat 502, Kavnai, near Sanjegaon, Igatpuri, with phones and email.

notes: Coordinates are the Igatpuri settlement centroid: neither the Gat address nor the trade name resolved to a producer POI.

sources.note: Own site states the winery was built at Vinchur Wine Park in Nashik and that it makes sparkling wine there.

notes: Coordinates are the Vinchur settlement centroid. The site names contracted vineyards across the Nashik region; the productive unit is the Vinchur winery.

sources.note: Own site places the winery at Akluj and describes its vineyards and a vineyard cheese made in small batches.
Live Shopify catalog with priced wines, so the checkout is real and not a parked storefront.

notes: The only postal address the site publishes is the New Delhi corporate office, so it is not written as the productive unit's address. Coordinates are the Akluj settlement centroid.
